instructions: Select the next Minecraft base workflow from the observations and available_actions. Respect user priority and permissions. Handle safe dusk return before distant work. Prefer food production prerequisites when food stock is low. Use observed inventory, warehouse stock and crop maturity; never invent supplies or completed work. Wait when none of the permitted workflows can make progress.

criteria.seed_supply: Collect missing wheat seeds in a small batch and return them to the registered warehouse.
criteria.wood_supply: Collect missing natural wood in a small batch for tools and return it to the warehouse.
criteria.farm_setup: Use available seeds and a hoe to establish or replant the verified irrigated wheat farm.
criteria.farm_harvest: Harvest actually mature wheat, replant and deposit the produce.
criteria.bake_food: Use at least three actually observed wheat, withdrawing warehouse supplies if needed, to craft bread at the existing worktable and deposit it.
criteria.base_return: Return through verified ground and the real doorway to the registered base.
criteria.warehouse_store: Deposit actually held supplies into the registered warehouse and verify both inventory changes.
criteria.warehouse_take: Withdraw actually observed warehouse supplies required by the next permitted task.
criteria.tool_craft: Craft a missing required tool from available materials using the existing worktable.
criteria.explore: Observe new safe ground for a missing resource when the local verified options are exhausted.
criteria.shelter: Close the verified base door and remain inside until daylight and a safe exit are observed.
criteria.wait: Preserve progress and wait for an actual resource, crop, daylight or route condition to change.
